## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy featuring a big, round, fat face and little blue eyes. His ears famously stick out like flaps, a prominent and objectionable feature that has been noted to look as though they ought to be trained with a rubber band to keep from protruding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P40](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0040)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a very serious young man who intends to become a minister. He also harbors a dread of failing in English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P41](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0041)_
